description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers for a model, comparing three distinct measures: the sparsity ratio before the gate, the sparsity ratio after the gate, and the sparsity ratio after the average gate. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 1 to 20, with tick marks at intervals of 5, and the y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, ranging from 0.0 to 0.8. The blue dashed line, labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003," starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.8 at layer 1 and gradually decreases to around 0.03 by layer 20. The orange dotted line, labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126," begins at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.8 at layer 1 and decreases to about 0.4 by layer 20. The green solid line, labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080," starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.8 at layer 1 and decreases to around 0.3 by layer 20. All three lines show a general downward trend as the layer number increases, with the sparsity ratio after the gate being higher than the sparsity ratio before the gate and after the average gate.
